default_equivalence: Exact source reversal: remove new generic and constant guards, reproduces original GSU text exactly. Therefore default=false is original control and datapath, not only sampled ALU tests.
limitations: ALU equivalence is randomized/directed, not exhaustive over every register value. No full renderer RTL simulation was performed here.
Inventory covers all bytes of assembled code with immediate bytes excluded and macro expansion decoded; computed jump runtime behavior is not exhaustively proven.
No Quartus run, area estimate, timing closure or hardware claim. Parent owns integrated mapping/fitting and system tests.

RACING_RENDERER_PROFILE=true intentionally does not implement ASR, DIV2, ROL, ROR, XOR, signed MULT, FMULT, LMULT, SEX or MERGE. Unsupported opcodes are not trapped. A different uploaded GSU program/save state must be audited or rebuilt with profile=false.
Full generic=false keeps existing core semantics; original core issues, if any, are outside this change.
